components.content: Lot One opens to the list first. Nothing is held back for later.

Renders from content/pages.json once any page has a menu label;
           until then these hand-written section links stand.
A pen is not bought. It is cut for the hand that will hold it.

We cut reed pens to your nib angle, cook our own soot ink, and burnish paper the slow
            way. Four items open the shop. Put your name down and you will hear first.

The sign-up form is a symbol: drawn once in the builder,
               bound to a backend form in the CMS (Symbols -> Sign-up form),
               placed here and in the closer. Ids are avoided on purpose so
               instances can repeat without duplicating them.
One message when the shop opens. Nothing else, ever.

Each lot is cut, cooked, or burnished in one run, then the run closes. Numbers are the order they leave the bench.
